item.title: Analyze Investment Strategies
item.description:
Archive note: This tutorial was written in October 2021. Its dataset, examples, external data-download instructions, and reported results reflect that period.

Introduction

In this tutorial, we will learn how to analyze a naive fixed investment strategy for Bitcoin. If you don’t know what is Bitcoin, I suggest you learn some fundamentals about cryptology, computer networking, and distributed systems. You may find this introduction helpful.

Any comments here about investing are scams. This is only a technical tutorial.
